item.text:
<linkedin_post>Kimi K3.1 Pro is available through an OpenAI-compatible API endpoint, so developers can try it with tools that support that interface. The article’s author used the LLM command-line tool to send the same SVG prompt at each of Kimi’s three reasoning levels: low, medium and max.

The author also ran the prompt against Kimi K3 at those levels, making it possible to compare the generated images across both models. The LLM endpoint command does not log results, so the author saved the output and reasoning trace separately.

Moonshot says it will release the full K3.1 Pro model weights by November 4. Until then, the model is available through its API.</linkedin_post>
